title: Length of the tape source list
statement: For every finite-state Turing machine $M$ with Boolean input alphabet, all $n,t\in\mathbb{N}$, and each work tape $	au$, the source list for tape $	au$ at time $t$ has length $B+1$, where $B$ is the number of bits in a snapshot.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Turing machine over Boolean symbols
